text:
tariq: kicking off onboarding for sandpiper-embed-compact (320d). doing two quant variants: per-channel int4 static and nf4-dynamic4. main checks: recall@1/5/10, MRR, topk-overlap, and cluster cohesion (silhouette + islanding). running prod-holdout + shorttail sets.

zoe: nice. use the shorttail split qlen<=12 as our primary spike detector. what harness command?

tariq: using the lightweight harness to iterate quickly, command: 
```
./eval/quickrun --model sandpiper-embed-compact \
  --quant static-int4,dynamic4 \
  --datasets prod-holdout-60k,shorttail-8k \
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,mrr@10,topk-overlap,silhouette,nn-islanding \
  --batch 512 --seed 13 --save artifacts/sandpiper/3776543210
```

alana: any early numbers?

tariq: first-pass summary (seed=13, single trial):
- baseline (oak-embed-large) recall@10 = 0.705
- sandpiper-dyn4 recall@10 = 0.688 (delta -0.017)
- sandpiper-static-int4 recall@10 = 0.672 (delta -0.033)
- shorttail recall@1: baseline 0.498 -> dyn4 0.462 -> static4 0.417
- top10-overlap (dyn4) = 0.81 vs baseline 0.88
- silhouette: baseline 0.18 -> dyn4 0.20 -> static4 0.19
- nn-islanding increased from 0.09 -> static4 0.15
- latency improvements: static4 3.2ms/vec, dyn4 4.6ms/vec, baseline 8.9ms/vec
- est cost reduction (static4) ~40%

ci-bot: artifacts: https://internal.redwood/artefacts/sandpiper/3776543210. Note: recall@1 shorttail drop statistically significant p<0.005.

leo: hmm silhouette up but recall down like usual. could be class boundary shifts; do we have per-query margin stats?

tariq: running margin histogram now and a shorttail confusion by category (NE, faq, code-search). early peek: named-entity queries show largest drop.

zoe: try quick mitigations: 1) L2-normalize vectors after quant, 2) calibrate using shorttail-augmented set, 3) try per-channel asymmetric quant for embeddings only.

alana: also test a hybrid fetch+rerank: sandpiper fetch top200 then rerank top50 with oak-embed-large for qlen<=12. cheaper than full routing.

tariq: will run L2-normalize + embedding-only per-channel asymmetric static-int4 and the hybrid rerank. if rerank recovers >85% of shorttail recall loss at <8% cost, propose enabling as a temporary mitigation.

leo: sounds good. tag me when plots land. :mag:
